bbbAccreditation._note: Better Business Bureau accreditation: a private business-trust program, NOT a government certification or designation. Keep it out of the SBA, SAM.gov and California records and out of every certification list. BBB Trademark Usage Guidelines: on the web, show only BBB's dynamic seal, hot-linked from BBB's seal server (never copied into this repo, re-hosted, altered, recolored, cropped or redrawn), linked to the BBB Business Profile, with the words "Click for Review" next to or below it (components/BbbSeal.tsx does all three). The site uses BBB's compact 160x82 seal (ACCREDITED BUSINESS, Click for Profile, no rating; Bruce's pick, 2026-11-17). Never write the BBB rating as text anywhere: BBB allows it only where it can be revised at once. Never imply BBB endorses a product or service.
